acceptanceCriteria: A make target regenerates REQUIREMENTS.tsv, and the check's failure message names it and says to stage specs first.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from agent friction. `make -s spec-requirements-check` detects drift, but regenerating the file takes `script/gen-spec-requirements.sh > docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv`, which enumerates the git index, so the spec has to be staged first. Agents repeatedly searched for this command.
